critical_code_review_comments: Minor: The 3D-mode caption card alternation under software WebGL is quite slow (observed ~15-17s between swaps) relative to the still-mode's ~6s cadence. If the spec intends 'alternates every ~6s' for both modes, the 3D variant may be gating card swaps on frame progression rather than a steady timer; consider decoupling or shortening the 3D cycle for parity with the still fallback.

The /demo page caches the previous completed replay's state briefly on reload before 'Waiting for the first frame...' appears when the attempt POST is slow; non-blocking but easy to misread as 'stuck at Entrance' in headless runs (was the exact symptom in iter 16). Current UI is correct once frames start flowing (~1-2s).
seed_data_creation: Created 4 replay attempts via /api/demo/replays (v1 x3, v2 x1). All 4 attempts and their 127 attempt_events deleted after testing. Older replay attempts and the 'My room' route were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 16b replay fixes are fully compliant. Important: /demo replay stops progressing frame counter at 'Frame 12 of 12' before all cues finish firing (last Reception desk spoken cue occurs ~24s in; replay-progress ends at '12 of 12 Replay finished' only after that). When polling, do NOT short-circuit on 'Frame 12 of 12 Replaying' - wait for 'Replay finished' OR until the Reception desk checkpoint is announced (~17-18s wallclock, 25s backend-elapsed). Headless WebGL takes ~17-18s per complete v1/v2 replay. Reduced-motion CSS media + canvas.getContext override both reliably trigger the still fallback. Four created replay IDs were cleaned up.
